description: Search field and selection of one option, with keyboard navigation.

howToUse: Use it to pick one option from a long list, where typing a few letters is faster than scrolling: city, customer, product.
Give it a `label` and, when it helps, a `hint` saying what can be searched ("Name or tax ID").
Group long lists with `group` on each option, and add `description` or `avatar` when the label alone does not tell two options apart.
Turn on `clearable` when "no choice" is a valid answer.
Set `emptyMessage` to say what to do when nothing matches.
alternatives: Fewer than about seven options: Select or RadioGroup.
A list of actions, not values: Menu or Command.

keyboard.action: Opens the list. With the list open, moves to the next or previous option.
With the list open, goes to the first or last option.
Closes the list and keeps the typed text.
Closes the list and moves on to the next field.

props.name: options
props.description: Suggested options. With `filter` (default) they are filtered by the typed text.

props.name: value
props.description: `value` of the selected option (controlled). `null` = nothing selected.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired when an option is selected (or `null` when cleared).

props.name: inputValue
props.description: Controlled input text (for async suggest, filter outside and pass `filter={false}`).

props.name: label
props.description: Field label (mono eyebrow above the input).

props.name: filter
props.type: boolean | ((option: ComboboxOption, query: string) => boolean) | undefined
props.description: Filters options by the typed text. `false` = the list comes already filtered.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon on the left of the input (default: magnifier).

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Message when no option matches the search.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Starts with the list open (uncontrolled), as in previews and catalogs. Default `false`.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Shows the clear button when there is text. Default `true`.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.
